prioritizedIssues.description: Element "button" should not be focusable within the subtree of an element with 'aria-hidden' attribute

fix.suggested: Remove tabindex or ensure parent does not have aria-hidden="true"
fix.explanation: Interactive elements inside aria-hidden containers should not be keyboard accessible. Either remove aria-hidden from parent or make the button non-focusable.

prioritizedIssues.userImpact: Keyboard users may focus on elements that are supposed to be hidden, causing confusion

prioritizedIssues.description: Input elements do not have an associated visible label

fix.suggested: Add aria-label or visible text label
fix.explanation: Add aria-label="Menu" or include visible text within the button for screen reader users.

prioritizedIssues.userImpact: Screen reader users may not understand the purpose of unlabeled controls

prioritizedIssues.description: Element may be covered when it receives focus, potentially obscuring it from view

fix.suggested: Ensure element is fully visible when focused, adjust z-index or scrolling behavior
fix.explanation: When this element receives focus, ensure it's not covered by overlays or other positioned elements.

prioritizedIssues.userImpact: Keyboard users may not see what element has focus

prioritizedIssues.description: Verify the word 'Upper' is not used to indicate visual position rather than logical position

fix.suggested: Use semantic/logical descriptions instead of visual position words
fix.explanation: Replace spatial references like 'Upper' with logical descriptions like 'First' or semantic structure.

prioritizedIssues.userImpact: Users with cognitive disabilities or screen readers may not understand visual position references
